en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: - To acquaint students with the basics of technical mechanics - statics, kinematics and dynamics; orient them in individual areas; to combine theoretical knowledge with basic calculations; verify knowledge.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Division of mechanics (allowance 2/2) a.Coordinate systemsb.Equilibrium conditions2.Force effects (allowance 2/2) a.Composition and decomposition of forcesb.Determining the resultant of forces and the resulting moment of forces3.Rod systems (allowance 2/2) a.Methods of solving rod systemsb.Basic chains4.Fundamentals of mass point kinematics (allowance 2/2) a.Speed ​​and accelerationb.Straight and circular movements5.Examples of plane curves (allowance 2/2) a.Cycloids, epicycloids, hypocycloids etc.b.The center of the osculating circle6.Kinematics of simultaneous movements (allowance 2/2) a.Basic decomposition of planar motionb.Analytical and vector description of motion7.General spatial movement of bodies (allowance 2/2) a.Spherical motionb.Pole of motion8.System of material points (allowance 2/2) a.The first and second sentences are impulsiveb.A collision of bodies9.Solid body (allowance 2/2) a.Moments of inertia and deviating momentsb.Center of gravity of the system of points10.Transformation of moments of inertia to different coordinate axes (allowance 2/2) a.stability of bodiesb.Steiner's theorem and Ellipsoid of inertia11.Motion equations of a rigid body (allowance 2/2) a.Planar and spherical motionb.Kinetic energy of a body12.Oscillatory motion - basic concepts (allowance 2/2) a.Undamped mechanical oscillationb.Examples of harmonic motion13.Forced mechanical oscillation (allowance 2/2) a.Resonance and its useb.Kinematic excitation14.Anharmonic Motion (Replacement Unit) (allowance 2/2) a.Nonlinear oscillationb.Vibration in the vehicle
